caption: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with chashu pork, a halved soft-boiled egg, nori, and menma, artfully arranged in a blue-and-white patterned bowl. Warm lighting highlights the dish against a dark, textured background.

segments_info.text: Dark, speckled granite surface with subtle texture and faint light reflections near edges.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish-white meat, visible marbling, and a slightly glistening surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough, uneven surface.
The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles and toppings with visible oil sheen and scattered green flecks.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale yellow, slightly translucent, fibrous strips with a glossy surface.
A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange yolk, creamy white, and a slightly textured surface with a small green onion garnish.
Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate wavy line pattern and slightly raised rim.
A metallic spoon with a smooth, reflective surface and a slightly worn, curved bowl shape.
